steps.content: Sand howls and engine roars.

The Legion's vehicle belts ahead with a vroom at full speed, its body covered in scratches and its roof completely torn off. Passengers who should have been distributed across several vehicles are now crammed into this battle-damaged transport.
Someone in the car leans out dangerously to shout at the girl sprinting desperately behind.

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: Hella, faster! That thing behind you is literally gonna bite your ass!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: HELP HELP HELP! Cut the crap and just pull me up already! Arghhhh—!!!!
Hella's legs pump like pistons until finally, with one desperate leap, she grabs the outstretched hand and gets yanked aboard shakily.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Everyone hold tight, I'm speeding up!

The next instant, the vehicle swerves sharply around a broken rock, nearly throwing Hella off the edge where she's perched. But the turn also gives her a perfect view of their pursuer in all its terrifying glory.

Behind them, sand and Mania have fused into an impenetrable darkness that hugs the ground, advancing with overwhelming force. Countless tiny, razor-sharp debris swirls within the massive storm, transforming it into a colossal meat grinder racing forward at over a hundred miles per hour.

This is no ordinary sandstorm. What swirls within the wind isn't sand, but tiny metal-like fragments, attracted and linked together by Mania, dancing to form a sky-darkening <color=#fb9259>black magnetic sandstorm</color> that swallows everything caught in its path.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Something's wrong. We've been moving sideways. We should've escaped its path by now, unless...
Visibility on the sides of the car plummets as the black sand closes in on the Legion.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Damn it! The storm is tracking our movements. It's <color=#fb9259>hunting us down</color>!

A massive rock hurtles past, missing Hella's head by inches before smashing the Legion vehicle's side mirror. Within seconds, metal fragments in the hurricane behind them shred the rock to pieces, reducing it to dust that blends into the raging storm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: NOOO! I didn't survive all those scammers and desert bandits only to die here... Ninety-Nine, Hecate, dummy ${PlayerName}, anybody—help me! I swear I'll never steal anything ever again, waaaaaah...

Debris from the storm hammers against the vehicle, stripping away patches of paint. The fragments strike with an eerie rhythm, forming whispers that penetrate Hella's ears, compelling her to look back. When she does, she hears a deeper drone from behind them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's that sound? What is... that?

steps.speaker: Whispers in the Storm
steps.content: Stay...
The entire vehicle strains forward in a desperate attempt to break free. Only Hella is looking back, witnessing the dense black shadow lurking at the heart of the magnetic storm.

steps.speaker: Whispers in the Storm
steps.content: Stay... Stay here... with us...!
With a piercing shriek, a massive boulder comes hurling through the air, flying straight toward Horo in the driver's seat!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Horo! Watch out—ugh!
Hella collapses limply on top of Horo. She's pushed Horo away, but couldn't dodge the boulder herself.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella?! ...Damn it!
She has no time to check on Hella and slams down on the accelerator. The engine lets out a dying roar, but that dark shadow is still slowly closing in on their vehicle.

Sunlight vanishes behind the swirling dust, plunging everything into darkness. Contamination grows thicker, distorting vision with dancing spots. The tapping sounds transform from whispers into piercing shrieks that stab painfully at the eardrums. Until...
[Transition, add a resonating sound effect of Aurum Secretum activation]

The heavy darkness is cut open, and light suddenly bursts forth. Into view comes a massive metal device of bizarre design. Mounted at the center of a small sand boat, it radiates a soft golden glow that drives back both the storm and contamination.
Several figures in black robes operate the device, their faces impossible to discern. They rotate the instrument, aiming it directly at the dark shadow at the center of the magnetic storm...
[Still frame, Aurum Secretum activation sound effect + monster roaring sound effect, possibly with the monster shadow portrait shaking]
